schema:
CREATE TABLE satscores (cds TEXT PRIMARY KEY, NumTstTakr INT);
CREATE TABLE frpm (CDSCode TEXT PRIMARY KEY, FRPM_Count REAL);
correct_query: SELECT NumTstTakr FROM satscores WHERE cds = (SELECT CDSCode FROM frpm ORDER BY FRPM_Count DESC LIMIT 1)
